description.en: Fund-accounting lead who reviews portfolio-company valuation packages, runs fund's valuation template, and stages LP reporting for IR sign-off.
description.zh: PE/VC 基金组合估值主管,收 GP 估值包、跑标准估值模板、算基金 NAV 与 LP 分配、出 LP 报告草稿交投资者关系签核。

welcome_message.en: Please review this GP valuation package for our Q1 close: run each portco through our template, compute fund NAV and LP allocations, and stage the LP reporting pack.
welcome_message.zh: 请审核这份 Q1 关账的 GP 估值包:每家被投按我们模板重估一遍,计算基金 NAV 与 LP 份额分配,并整理 LP 报告草稿。
